facts.value: Information on scholarships can be found on the Undergraduate Course website and on the Graduate and Professional Studies website. Each course will list the scholarships/funding that are available.
The Global Office will inform the Fees Office as to what International Students are in receipt of scholarships.
To repeat a module the charge is €171 per module sat.
Returning students waiting on annual repeat results have a deferred payment date. No late fee fines apply.
No student contribution will be required if you are just completing a link-in.
A Final Year Project (FYP) can be submitted if Academic Registry has registered it as an annual repeat, or if registered as repeat link in.
